name: ZigZag EA
summary: This EA uses the ZigZag indicator to identify trend reversal points and opens trades in the direction of the newly formed trend. It enters positions when a new ZigZag leg is confirmed and exits based on opposite signals or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The strategy aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend swings by following the ZigZag pivot points.
summary_zh: 该EA利用ZigZag指标识别趋势反转点，并在新趋势方向上开仓交易。当新的ZigZag波段确认后入场，根据反向信号或固定止盈止损出场。策略旨在通过跟随ZigZag拐点来捕捉中长线趋势波段。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ZigZag指标识别市场的高点和低点拐点，在趋势方向确认后入场交易。入场条件为当ZigZag指标确认新的波峰或波谷形成时，在趋势延续方向开仓——波谷形成后做多，波峰形成后做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，以及当ZigZag指标形成反向拐点时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA可能支持固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于止损距离和账户余额来确定每笔交易的风险敞口。策略假设ZigZag拐点标记了趋势的真实反转，但需注意ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，已确认的拐点可能随价格变化而移动，这给实盘交易带来不确定性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the ZigZag indicator to identify market swing highs and lows, entering trades after trend direction confirmation. Entry conditions trigger when the ZigZag indicator confirms a new peak or trough formation — going long after a trough and short after a peak. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as closing positions when the ZigZag forms an opposite pivot point. Position sizing may support fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management relies on stop-loss distance and account balance to determine risk exposure per trade. The strategy assumes ZigZag pivot points mark genuine trend reversals, but it is important to note that the ZigZag indicator has repainting characteristics, meaning confirmed pivots may shift as price evolves, introducing uncertainty in live trading.

parameters.name: ZigZag_Depth
parameters.description: ZigZag深度参数，控制拐点检测的灵敏度
parameters.description_en: ZigZag depth; controls turning point sensitivity

parameters.name: ZigZag_Deviation
parameters.description: ZigZag偏差参数，最小拐点间距百分比
parameters.description_en: ZigZag deviation; minimum turning point spacing %

parameters.name: ZigZag_Backstep
parameters.description: ZigZag回退参数，防止过近拐点形成
parameters.description_en: ZigZag backstep; prevents close turning points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

pros: ZigZag指标能有效识别市场关键拐点，入场逻辑清晰直观
策略逻辑简单易懂，便于交易者理解和调整参数
跟随趋势方向交易，具有正向期望的潜力
pros_en: ZigZag indicator effectively identifies key market pivot points with clear and intuitive entry logic
Strategy logic is simple and easy to understand, allowing traders to easily adjust parameters
Trades in trend direction, carrying potential for positive expectancy
cons: ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，历史信号可能随价格变化而改变，实盘信号可靠性存疑
缺乏对市场震荡行情的过滤机制，可能在横盘区间频繁止损
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动和低波动市场中表现不一致
cons_en: ZigZag indicator has repainting characteristics — historical signals may change as price evolves, raising reliability concerns for live signals
Lacks filtering mechanism for ranging markets, potentially causing frequent stop-outs in sideways conditions
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss do not account for market volatility changes, leading to inconsistent performance across varying volatility environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或均线方向）以避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
引入ATR动态止损止盈以适应市场波动率变化
添加ZigZag信号确认机制（如等待N根K线确认拐点不重绘后再入场）
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., ADX or moving average direction) to avoid frequent trades in ranging markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to market volatility changes
Add a ZigZag signal confirmation mechanism (e.g., wait N bars to confirm the pivot does not repaint before entering)

risk_points: ZigZag指标重绘问题可能导致虚假入场信号
缺乏震荡行情过滤器可能在横盘市场中连续亏损
固定止损未考虑点差和滑点影响
risk_points_en: ZigZag repainting issue may produce false entry signals
Lack of ranging market filter may cause consecutive losses in sideways markets
Fixed stop-loss does not account for spread and slippage impact
